PLAN "Climber Shoulder Rebuild - 12 Week Upper Focus (Right Impingement, No Overhead Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Pain-free upper body strength without overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Scapular Control Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper A - Pull and Cuff":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 2x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 2x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper B - Push and Posture":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
